params.body:
Follow-up to #370.

The text check for inspiration-only sources (`namesInInspiration`) matched only the source row's name. The Edelman row is called "Keeping Current" (site edelman.com), so a sentence naming "Edelman", such as the Edelman Trust Barometer, passed the publish gate and did not show up in `bin/inspiration-only.mjs`. Edelman as a whole is read for inspiration only, so the publisher's name should be caught as well.

- The site's name is matched next to the source's name: edelman.com gives "Edelman", insights.ypulse.com gives "Ypulse". A two- or three-letter second level such as `co.uk` is skipped. Names under four characters are still ignored.
- If the source name and the site name are the same word, the source name's spelling wins, so messages still say "YPulse".
- A sentence is listed once per source, even when it names both.

Tests: a new case in `test/inspiration.test.mjs`. Full suite 1329/1335; the 6 failures are the known report-render tests that need pdftoppm.

After deploy, `node bin/inspiration-only.mjs` on the box lists any post that names Edelman.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: Inspiration check finds the publisher by its site name
